central_hypothesis: A coherence-weighted spin-fluctuation kernel improves held-out prediction of a cuprate pairing endpoint over a spin-only kernel.
replication_rationale: At least three independent crystals per doping point support separation of specimen and instrument variability.
randomization_blinding: Randomize beamtime blocks; blind sample identifiers during analysis when facility procedures permit.
statistics: hierarchical measurement-error models; leave-one-doping-out and leave-one-crystal-out validation; posterior predictive checks; sensitivity analyses
missing_data: Reason-coded missingness; no imputation of primary endpoints or missing primary spectroscopy; covariate imputation only if justified.
safety_ethics: human review before facility or publication decisions
